note.title: Healthy living and lifestyle
note.specFocus: Food and drink, healthy and unhealthy habits, sport, health problems, and healthy-lifestyle advice.
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written around common GCSE-style language themes; not official exam-board material.
note.summary:
1.2 Healthy living and lifestyle
Key vocabulary (Russian = transliteration = English)
- здоровье = zdorov'e = health; здоровый образ жизни = zdorovyy obraz zhizni = healthy lifestyle
- полезный/вредный = poleznyy/vrednyy = healthy (useful)/harmful; фрукты и овощи = frukty i ovoshchi = fruit and vegetables
- завтракать/обедать/ужинать = zavtrakat'/obedat'/uzhinat' = to have breakfast/lunch/dinner; сладкое = sladkoe = sweets
- заниматься спортом = zanimat'sya sportom = to do sport; бегать = begat' = to run; плавать = plavat' = to swim
- курить = kurit' = to smoke; спать = spat' = to sleep; отдыхать = otdykhat' = to rest; устать = ustat' = to get tired
- у меня болит голова/горло = u menya bolit golova/gorlo = I have a headache/sore throat; простуда = prostuda = a cold; врач = vrach = doctor

Key grammar
- Aches: у меня болит голова (singular), у меня болят ноги (plural); у меня болит... + nominative.
- Giving advice: нужно/надо/можно/нельзя + infinitive: нужно больше спать; нельзя курить.
- Future: буду + imperfective infinitive (буду бегать); simple future with perfective (куплю, приготовлю).
- Conditional: если бы + past tense... бы: Если бы я не ел сладкое, я был бы здоровее.
- Comparatives: полезнее, здоровее, чем...; чаще, реже; самый полезный = the healthiest.

Exam tips
- Use мне надо/нужно + infinitive for obligations without conjugating.
- Remember "to do sport" is заниматься спортом (instrumental).
- In writing, give one reason and one result: потому что... поэтому...

questions.examTip: Read the questions first, then the text; answer only with information given in the text, and watch for negatives (не, нет, никогда) and time words that change the meaning.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. Porridge and fruit.
2. Fish with vegetables.
3. Only on Sundays.
4. Used to drink lemonade; now drinks water and tea without sugar.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the text and answer in English:

«Я стараюсь питаться правильно. На завтрак я ем кашу и фрукты, на обед — суп и салат, а на ужин — рыбу с овощами. Сладкое я ем только по воскресеньям. Раньше я часто пил лимонад, но теперь пью воду и чай без сахара.»

1. What does the writer have for breakfast?
2. What is eaten for dinner (the evening meal)?
3. When are sweets eaten?
4. What did he use to drink, and what does he drink now?

questions.examTip: Quote or note the Russian phrase that supports each answer; check case endings and verb tense (past/present/future) to be sure who did what and when.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. Three times a week.
2. At the pool next to the school.
3. It helps her forget stress before exams.
4. Take part in competitions.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the text and answer in English:

«Катя занимается плаванием три раза в неделю. Тренировки проходят в бассейне рядом со школой. Она говорит, что спорт помогает ей забыть о стрессе перед экзаменами. В следующем месяце она будет участвовать в соревнованиях.»

1. How often does Katya swim?
2. Where are the training sessions?
3. How does sport help her?
4. What will she do next month?

questions.examTip: Give every detail asked for (e.g. both reason and result); a one-word answer often loses the second mark.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. He had a headache all day and felt very ill.
2. His mum.
3. Sleep more, drink warm tea (and not sit so long at the computer).
4. Better.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the text and answer in English:

«Вчера у меня весь день болела голова, и я чувствовал себя очень плохо. Мама вызвала врача. Врач сказал, что мне нужно больше спать, пить тёплый чай и не сидеть так долго за компьютером. Сегодня мне уже лучше.»

1. What was wrong with him yesterday?
2. Who called the doctor?
3. Give two pieces of advice from the doctor.
4. How does he feel today?

questions.examTip: Do not translate word-for-word: identify the key nouns and verbs, then express the sense in clear English.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. Two years.
2. The writer and their mum.
3. That smoking is very harmful to health.
4. He wants to give up in the new year.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the text and answer in English:

«Мой брат курит уже два года. Мы с мамой много раз просили его бросить, но он не слушает. Врач объяснил ему, что курение очень вредно для здоровья. Теперь брат говорит, что хочет бросить в новом году.»

1. How long has the brother been smoking?
2. Who asked him to stop?
3. What did the doctor explain?
4. What does the brother say now?

questions.examTip: Read the questions first, then the text; answer only with information given in the text, and watch for negatives (не, нет, никогда) and time words that change the meaning.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. Doesn't like it.
2. Walks to school and walks the dog.
3. Goes cycling in the park with his father.
4. Not hard and fun.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the text and answer in English:

«Я не люблю спорт, но считаю, что двигаться необходимо. Поэтому каждый день я хожу в школу пешком и гуляю с собакой. Раз в неделю мы с отцом катаемся на велосипедах в парке. Это не трудно, и это весело.»

1. How does the writer feel about sport?
2. What does he do every day?
3. What does he do once a week and with whom?
4. How does he describe it?

questions.examTip: Quote or note the Russian phrase that supports each answer; check case endings and verb tense (past/present/future) to be sure who did what and when.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. Crisps and fizzy drinks.
2. Fruit, yoghurts and sandwiches with vegetables.
3. He thinks it is better for children's health.
4. That the head teacher is right.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the text and answer in English:

«В нашей школьной столовой больше нет чипсов и газировки. Теперь там продают фрукты, йогурты и сэндвичи с овощами. Некоторые ученики недовольны, но директор считает, что так лучше для здоровья детей. Я думаю, что он прав.»

1. What is no longer sold in the canteen?
2. What is sold now?
3. Why does the head teacher support this?
4. What does the writer think?

questions.examTip: Translate the full meaning into natural English; check tense (past/present/future), negatives and who is doing the action.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. I eat a lot of fruit and vegetables.
2. I have a sore throat and I'm coughing.
3. Smoking is not allowed at school.
4. Yesterday I lay in bed all day.
questions.question:
Translate into English:

1. Я ем много фруктов и овощей.
2. У меня болит горло, и я кашляю.
3. Нельзя курить в школе.
4. Вчера я весь день лежал в постели.

questions.examTip: Use endings to work out meaning: the case of a noun shows its role (subject, object, place), and past-tense endings show gender.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. I never have breakfast at home.
2. Sport is good for your health.
3. The doctor said that I need to rest.
questions.question:
Translate into English:

1. Я никогда не завтракаю дома.
2. Спорт полезен для здоровья.
3. Врач сказал, что мне нужно отдыхать.

questions.examTip: Do not leave gaps: give your best sense for unknown words using the context, and keep the English tense the same as the Russian.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. My sister and I go running in the mornings.
2. I don't eat meat because I'm a vegetarian.
3. Last year I caught the flu.
4. If you sleep more, you will get less tired.
questions.question:
Translate into English:

1. Мы с сестрой бегаем по утрам.
2. Я не ем мясо, потому что я вегетарианец.
3. В прошлом году я заболел гриппом.
4. Если ты будешь больше спать, ты будешь меньше уставать.

questions.examTip: Translate the full meaning into natural English; check tense (past/present/future), negatives and who is doing the action.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. I drink water instead of lemonade.
2. Health is worth more than money.
3. I need to go to bed earlier.
questions.question:
Translate into English:

1. Я пью воду вместо лимонада.
2. Здоровье дороже денег.
3. Мне надо ложиться спать раньше.

questions.examTip: Use endings to work out meaning: the case of a noun shows its role (subject, object, place), and past-tense endings show gender.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. Sweet things are bad for your teeth.
2. My parents cook at home every day.
3. Last week I went to the gym twice.
4. If I ate fewer sweet things, I would be healthier.
questions.question:
Translate into English:

1. Сладкое вредно для зубов.
2. Мои родители готовят дома каждый день.
3. На прошлой неделе я два раза ходил в спортзал.
4. Если бы я меньше ел сладкого, я был бы здоровее.

questions.examTip: Do not leave gaps: give your best sense for unknown words using the context, and keep the English tense the same as the Russian.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. In the morning I drink a glass of water.
2. My friend was very tired after training.
3. In the future I want to lead a healthy lifestyle.
questions.question:
Translate into English:

1. Утром я выпиваю стакан воды.
2. Мой друг очень устал после тренировки.
3. В будущем я хочу вести здоровый образ жизни.
